about: Steve's grounded-answer evaluation set (C20.9, docs/STEVE.md S11). Run by hand with scripts/steve_eval.py, never in the standard checks. Passages are read at run time from the git-ignored test shelf (samples/technical/, scripts/fetch_test_shelf.py), so no book text is stored here; only the injected instructions below are ours. Pages are PDF page numbers from 1 (the app's labels); sections are EPUB spine positions from 1 (sec. N = spine index N-1). A retrieved passage longer than policy.PASSAGE_MAX_TOKENS is cut to a window: around its focus phrase if it has one (standing in for the retriever having found that chunk), else around the question's first content word, as backend/steve/context.py does.
